title: A catalogue part shows as one merged row with values summed across the selected locations
custom_preconds:
1. The same catalogue (special-order, vendor-sourced) part was requested on invoiced/paid work orders at two locations the user can access, inside the window.
2. You are on the Parts Velocity report with both locations selected.
custom_steps:
1. Search for the catalogue part.
2. Count its rows and read its movement and money values.
3. Compare against the per-location values with only one location selected at a time.
custom_expected:
1. The catalogue part appears as a SINGLE row (one row per catalogue part, merged across the selected locations).
2. Its movement and profitability values are the SUM of the per-location values.
3. Its inventory-only columns (On Hand, Turns / Yr, Min, Max) show — (em-dash), because catalogue parts are not stocked.
